about: Front HI0: findings of the hi lint (src/i18n/lint/, profile hi) that are correct Hindi in one string, each with a reason. Keys are the lint's string ids; `words` are the matched words allowed in that string only, `rules` whole rules, `placeholders` added placeholders.
